meta.description: Temperature and humidity per room from Tapo sensors, and air quality from a Ruuvi Air: CO2, fine dust (PM2.5), VOC and NOx indices, temperature, humidity, pressure and a quality score. Feeds the Ramka's climate and air pages.

tapo-t315.description: A small battery-powered sensor with a display that reports temperature and humidity over the low-power radio of a Tapo hub (tested with the H200).
tapo-t315.does: Reports each room's temperature and humidity to Home Assistant through the hub; the TP-Link Smart Home integration adds them as sensors.

ruuvi-air.description: A Bluetooth air-quality sensor (Sensirion SEN66) that measures CO2, fine dust, VOC, NOx, temperature, humidity and pressure and rates the air with a score.
ruuvi-air.does: Home Assistant picks up its broadcasts through Bluetooth proxies and the core ruuvitag_ble integration. A proxy on a classic ESP32 receives only data format 6, which carries no PM1, PM4 or PM10.
